name: Average Shrimp 57
author: JaydipPrajapati1910
description: Neon gradient rounded red toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: box-shadow becomes inset -5px 0 0 0 #000000, inset 5px 0 0 0 #000000, inset 6px 0 0 0 #ffffff, inset -4px 6px 11px -5px #000000, inset 1px 1px 0 0 #ffffff, -6px 4px 11px -7px #000000, background changes from linear-gradient(to right, #fdfcfb 37%, #e5e5e5 61%) to linear-gradient(to right, #e5e5e5 39%, #fdfcfb 63%), text color changes to #119400.
